status_meaning.ACCESS_BLOCKED: requires authentication, payment or authorization not granted
status_meaning.LISTED: public provider index lists a monthly file covering the day; content not checked
status_meaning.NOT_LISTED: no file listed (or acquired data does not cover the day)
status_meaning.OBSERVED_LOCAL: acquired locally and checksum-verified (IAQF panel or acquisition manifest)
status_meaning.UNVERIFIED_SOURCE: venue/source plausible but no listing or acquisition checked
